title: Introducing Geist Serif
summary:
Geist started as a monospace typeface for developers, built for the editors and terminals where they spend their day doing their work. From there it grew into Geist Sans for product interfaces, and then into Geist Pixel, which was inspired by the grids of early computer screens.

Today, we're adding a new member to the family: Geist Serif.

Geist Serif is a high-contrast display serif built on the same foundations as Geist

title: Strix now supports Vercel AI Gateway
summary:
Strix, the open-source AI penetration testing tool, can now run on any of the 400+ models on Vercel AI Gateway.

Strix can reach models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Kimi, GLM, Deepseek, and others through a single API with no markup, removing the need to sign up for multiple providers. Usage and cost are tracked across all models in AI Gateway.
